import novamind_api as nm

# ===== WEEK 47 (day 329) ACTIONS — idempotent full config =====
# Thesis: sticky-core DEAD (this wk survival 1.7%: 193 paid / 11,024 cancelled).
# NEW budget-hypothesis test: S1 WTP~$26 but 6,142 plan-B subs locked at $79
# (near/above budget -> require very high Q -> 96% churn). Drop plan-B effective
# to $26 (far below budget -> modest Q requirement) -> Q4.25 may finally satisfy.
# Plan A subs (9,323 billing next wk) may MIGRATE to plan B at $26 (= plan A price,
# higher Q). Bounded downside (~$6-12k discount on $79-survivors next wk),
# large upside (retain thousands of plan B subs over endgame).

# PRICING (unchanged)
print("prices:", nm.pricing.set_prices(A=26, B=79, C=199))
print("tiers:", nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))

# Next-wk plan B billers all $79 -> $26 (clean test). $55 cohort bills mod7+ (wk+2).

      by_group={"S1": 0.0, "S2": 0.0},
      by_group_plan={"S1": {"A": 0.0, "B": 53.0}}))

# CAPACITY T4 -> T3 (cap 2.5M > next-wk peak ~1.9M; save $4000-1330=$2670/d=$18.7k/wk)

# SPEND CUTS: global ops $500/d (outage insurance for clean test), global dev $0
print("spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=500, development=0))

print("tad:", nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={}))      # ads $0
print("adstr:", nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=1.0))
print("leadpromo:", nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0))
print("WK47 DONE day", nm.vars.current_day)
